rules.paraphrase: Hourly work is billed in tenths of an hour.
Billed rates may not exceed negotiated rates without pre-approval; one rate increase a year; unapproved increases are paid at negotiated rates.
Approved travel time is paid at the base rate, excluding time spent on other matters.
Colour copies at most fifteen cents and black-and-white 0.85 cent a page; mileage at the state rate; coach air; meals at the per diem; no markup.
Costs other than routine ones need a budget line or prior written approval.
Bills are due no later than thirty days after the end of the month of service.
Hourly invoices carry date, person, task description, time in tenths, rate and itemised costs.
Fees may not exceed the agreed target budget without written approval.
Duplicate staffing and more than one attorney per task, deposition, hearing or meeting are not paid without approval; team changes need approval.
Budgets, invoices, staff meetings, clerical and secretarial work, training, marketing and basic research are not paid.
Online research, phone and fax, most meals, local travel, miscellaneous categories and overhead are not paid.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: Attorney conferencing within the office is generally not compensable unless a significant legal event requires it at the client's request.
Education cost of a replacement team member is borne by the firm.
No compensation for work outside the agreed scope or without express authority.
